text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
In a corner of the cafeteria, I spotted 
Mejiro Ardan, Mejiro Ryan, and Daiwa 
Scarlet chatting away.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
—Oh~! So both of you read shoujo manga, 
then!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Reading is an important hobby of 
mine. I enjoy shojo manga from all eras.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Y-Yeah. I mean, me too, you know...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Oh? What is the matter, Ryan? You seem to 
have been keeping an eye on your 
surroundings for a while now—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Ah, well, umm... It's just embarrassing if 
people find out I like shoujo manga—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: —*Cough, cough!* No, it's nothing!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
I know! Have either of you read any good 
manga recently?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: As for me, well, umm...

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
"A recent one that was great is 'Koi Koi 
Passing'! That scene in the classroom 
after school where the protagonist finally 
realizes her childhood friend's feelings, 
you know!"

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
It's the ultimate chance for the childhood 
friend... and yet, she can't summon the 
courage here either—and ends up pushing 
the protagonist away!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
"It might be a royal road cliché, but I 
really think the best part of shojo manga 
is the emotional misunderstanding between 
the two!"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Indeed, you are quite right. Conversely, 
having your hearts align only to be tossed 
about by cruel fate is another royal 
classic.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Ah, I totally get it! And another thing—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Ah... N-No, it's nothing...

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
By the way, how about you, Ryan-san? Are 
there any good manga you've read recently?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Huh! Ah, yeah... My recommendation is...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: I-I'm... U-Uhh...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
"—Ah, s-sorry! I haven't really had time 
to read it lately... Ardan-san, would you 
mind reading it instead?"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Understood. Allow me to tell you the tale, 
then.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
I've always been drawn to historical and 
fantasy works. "The Faraway Dragon River," 
which I read recently, was one of them.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
"The scene that left the deepest 
impression was when the protagonist and 
their lover, torn apart by warring 
nations, met in secret under the cover of 
night to negotiate a truce—"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
A-A s-s-secret rendezvous...? Eh, 
e-eek...!?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Yes... The sad part is that we can only 
meet in secret now.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
"Considering the weight of what both are 
carrying, the inner conflict of having to 
suppress personal feelings and strictly 
stick to business..."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
However, as we spoke face-to-face, words 
began to pour out uncontrollably... and 
before we knew it, we were pouring our 
hearts and memories out to each other—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
And before they knew it, the two drew 
close— reaching for each other's hands—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: ...Whoa-whoa-whoa, whoa...! Eeeeek~~!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Ah, I can't do this anymoreee~!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After shouting that, Mejiro Ryan ran right 
past by my side...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Ryan, whatever is the matter...! —Oh? 
Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
"...Did you happen to overhear what we 
were just saying? Did I... do something 
weird to Ryan without realizing—"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Resistance... you say? What do you mean by 
that?
choice_data_list: Maybe I jumped into it too aggressively...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
—Come to think of it, what I just spoke 
about was the climax of the middle act... 
Did I just commit what is called a 
'spoiler'?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Ah... How careless of me. Next time, I 
must take greater care in conveying its 
charm.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I felt something was slightly off, but... 
Either way, Mejiro Ardan seemed firmly 
resolved to dedicate herself even further.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
I see... That's true, Ardan-san's 
introduction was wonderfully done, after 
all!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
“Still, dashing off on impulse like 
that... You're surprisingly sensitive at 
heart, Ryan-san.”

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Ryan has always been a rather 
sensitive child, after all—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
"That is precisely why I also wished to 
hear you speak at length about the charm 
of the work as perceived through your 
sensibilities, but—"

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
I'm really curious... If there's another 
chance next time, I'd definitely love to 
hear what Ryan-san has to say!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Indeed... We can arrange a more 
appropriate occasion sometime. Fufu—
